name: hockey-iq-trainer
description: Learn where to be on the ice. Read the play, pick your spot, and watch it unfold — hockey positioning training for young players.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android

comments.capacitor: Native packaging deps are NOT installed by default — the web game has zero runtime dependencies. When you're ready for the app stores, run: npm i -D @capacitor/cli && npm i @capacitor/core @capacitor/ios @capacitor/android
